Memorandum
1st. The King's Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
and the Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Georgia
are to meet at the City of Baltimore
on the 1st of April next, and
to hold a General Council of
the United Colonies.
2d. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Annapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, and to hold a General
Council of the United Colonies.
3d. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Georgia
are to meet at Savannah, in the
Province of Georgia, on the 1st of
April next, and to hold a General
Council of United Colonies.
4th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Annapois, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, and hold a General
Council of the United Colonies.
5th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Georgia
are to meet at Savannah, Georgia,
on the 1st of April next, and hold a
General Council of the United
Colonies.
6th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Anapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, and the Commissioners
for the Government of the Province
of Georgia are to meet at Savannah,
Georgia, on the 1st of April next,
and hold a General Council of the
United Colonies.
7th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Anapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, the Commissioners for
the Government of the Province of
Georgia are to meet at Savannah,
Georgia, on the 1st of April next,
and hold General Council of the
United Colonies.
8th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Anapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, the Commissioner for
the Government of the Province of
Georgia are to meet at Savannah,
Georgia, on the 1st of April next,
and hold a General Council of the
United Colonies.
9th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Anapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, the Commissioners for
the Government of the Province of
Georgia are to meet at Savannah,
Georgia, on the 1st of April next,
and hold a General Council of the
United Colonies.
10th. The Commissioners for the
Government of the Province of Maryland
are to meet at Anapolis, in the
Province of Maryland, on the 1st of
April next, the Commissioner for
the Government of the Province of
Georgia are to meet at Savannah,
</
